critique.evidence: Desktop is polished and cohesive: strong editorial headline, disciplined dark palette, clear cyan/red/green semantics, and a convincing split transaction/trace composition. Tablet remains orderly but becomes excessively tall. Mobile degrades substantially: typography and metadata are extremely small, rows become repetitive vertical slabs, the card requires a very long scroll, and the header shows a cramped clipped navigation strip with no visible wordmark. Tablet header labels are visibly truncated beneath the SWIPE treatment. These responsive compromises keep it below demo-ready 8.
critique.fix: Redesign the narrow layout instead of merely stacking it: use compact transaction summaries with expandable details, increase mobile body/metadata legibility, tighten vertical rhythm, and keep the evidence comparison prominent earlier. Replace the clipped header rail with a clean mobile navigation pattern and preserve a recognizable brand label; remove visibly truncated tablet labels.
